description: Defines the SymFloat class representing a symbolic floating-point number with operations and symbolic checks, used within the c10 namespace for PyTorch's symbolic computation.

classes.name: SymFloat
classes.description: Represents a symbolic or concrete floating-point number with arithmetic and symbolic operations.

methods.name: SymFloat
methods.description: Constructs a SymFloat from a double or a SymNode.

methods.name: toSymNodeImplUnowned
methods.description: Returns the unowned SymNodeImpl pointer.

methods.name: release
methods.description: Releases ownership of the SymNode.

methods.name: toSymNodeImpl
methods.description: Returns the SymNode representation.

methods.name: wrap_node
methods.description: Wraps the SymFloat into a SymNode with a base.

methods.name: expect_float
methods.description: Returns the concrete double value, asserting it's not symbolic.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Addition operator for SymFloat.

methods.name: operator-
methods.description: Subtraction operator for SymFloat.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplication operator for SymFloat.

methods.name: operator/
methods.description: Division operator for SymFloat.

methods.name: sym_eq
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing equality.

methods.name: sym_ne
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing inequality.

methods.name: sym_lt
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing less-than.

methods.name: sym_le
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing less-than or equal.

methods.name: sym_gt
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing greater-than.

methods.name: sym_ge
methods.description: Returns a SymBool representing greater-than or equal.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum of two SymFloat values.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum of two SymFloat values.

methods.name: sqrt
methods.description: Returns the square root of the SymFloat.

methods.name: guard_float
methods.description: Guards and returns the concrete float value, given file and line info.

methods.name: has_hint
methods.description: Checks if the SymFloat has a hint.

methods.name: is_symbolic
methods.description: Checks if the SymFloat is symbolic.

methods.name: as_float_unchecked
methods.description: Unsafely coerces SymFloat to double, assuming non-symbolic.
